Name: The Haunted Wardrobe
Author: TimBukTw0
Description:
Beneath [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/2_Willow_Lane]2 Willow Lane[/url] lies a forgotten basement, with a tale lost to time. Inside, a wardrobe sits untouched for decades, and something stirs within it. Why do you suddenly feel drawn to place your hat on the lonely mannequin?
The Haunted Wardrobe is a clothing collection mod that gives every hat, shirt, pair of pants, and boots a purpose beyond sitting forgotten in a chest. Donate your finds to the wardrobe and watch its power grow. The more you donate, the more it can give back: daily clothing drops, a teleportation furniture item, and eventually you might meet the ghost. 
[line]
[b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Donate any hat, shirt, pants, or boots to Vivienne's wardrobe to increase its power — compatible with modded clothing too! [/*]
[*]A Tiered donation system that progressively unlocks rewards the more you contribute.[/*]
[*]A clothing try on and buyback system (buyback is either 1000g minimum or 3x the sell price).[/*]
[*]A daily clothing drop system with multiple unlock methods: chop trees, catch fish, mine rocks, kill enemies, and more.[/*]
[*]A Fashion Fortune Chart furniture item that tracks your daily drop progress.[/*]
[*]A mini wardrobe furniture item that grants teleportation around town.[/*]
[*]The ghost herself, with a story to tell. Talk to her and learn about her past life through her dialogue.[/*]
[*]Endgame content where the Daily drop system now drops rare items.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Other things:[/b]
As of 1.0.3 I have done work for multiplayer, IT SHOULD work now. If it doesn't let me know!
As of 1.1.0 Save Data has been redone again, and now it actually supports modded items and wont be a broken mess. I changed the source menu into two buttons and now all modded items go into one menu for simplicity. Those items have their mod names in their tooltip when hovered over so you know which ones. A lot of clothing has been restricted from the Daily Drop system as that system is for the rare and obnoxious clothing.

Pan Hats have a special system to view a upgraded panhat on your head but you cant buy it.
Also Emily's Special Clothing is now functional with a bool in the config.

There is also some small config options for ease of use of the Daily Drops system. The keybind only works if you buy the item from the barrel when it unlocks. Daily Drops are seeded to be the same on said days.

[b]Shout Outs[/b]
Inspired by Stardew Aquarium and the many other "collect 'em all" style mods that make completing your collection actually feel rewarding. Thanks to the Stardew modding community for the tools and resources that made this possible.
